concepts.def: Psychologist who named six basic emotions

walkthroughs.body_html:
Psychologist Paul Ekman said all cultures share six basic emotions:

  • Happiness 😊
  • Sadness 😢
  • Anger 😠
  • Fear 😨
  • Surprise 😮
  • Disgust 🤢

Each emotion has its own facial expression.

Babies smile within months. Surprised eyebrows look the same from London to Tokyo.

That's why we call them universal.

A trigger is what starts the feeling:

  • Spider → fear.
  • Surprise gift → happiness.
  • Unfair grade → anger.

We can't always control triggers, but we can choose how we respond. 🌱
